title: Instagram Search Username Discovery
description: Discovers Instagram profile usernames from keyword search and web-indexed Instagram profile/post/reel results where the keyword appears in text snippets. Outputs usernames immediately so partial results survive failures.

keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: Search terms such as HOKA, Eliud Kipchoge, running shoes, marathon coach, or trail running.

maxResults.title: Maximum usernames to save
maxResults.description: Actor stops after saving this many unique Instagram usernames.

maxKeywords.title: Maximum keywords to process
maxKeywords.description: Maximum number of seed and generated keyword variants to process.

maxHashtags.title: Maximum hashtags to process
maxHashtags.description: Optional. Maximum number of hashtags to process if hashtag discovery is enabled.

maxHashtagPages.title: Pages per hashtag
maxHashtagPages.description: Optional. How many result pages to try per discovered hashtag if hashtag discovery is enabled.

searchResultLimit.title: Search users per keyword
searchResultLimit.description: Maximum direct Instagram search user results to save per keyword.

useWebSearch.title: Use web-indexed Instagram search
useWebSearch.description: Searches web-indexed Instagram profile/post/reel pages for keyword mentions in titles/snippets and extracts usernames.

maxWebSearchResultsPerKeyword.title: Web search usernames per keyword
maxWebSearchResultsPerKeyword.description: Maximum usernames to extract from web search result pages per keyword.

useHashtagDiscovery.title: Also use hashtag discovery
useHashtagDiscovery.description: Off by default because this actor is intended for keyword coverage beyond hashtags. Enable only if you want hashtag expansion too.

relatedSearchCount.title: Related hashtag search count
relatedSearchCount.description: Optional. How many hashtag search results to request when hashtag discovery is enabled.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Delay between Instagram API calls. Increase if you see rate limits.

checkpointEvery.title: Checkpoint every N usernames
checkpointEvery.description: Progress is saved after this many new usernames. Dataset rows are still pushed immediately.
